subject: Appointment of Permanent Superintendent
overview: The School Committee met to discuss key district initiatives and voted to appoint interim Superintendent Dr. Suzanne Galusi as the permanent superintendent, pending successful contract negotiations.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine bills, payrolls, capital purchases, grants, field trips, minutes, and a $1,000 donation to the orchestra program.

items.title: Mustang Moments
items.summary: The committee received updates on the Medford High School Best Buddies program and celebrated the district's Project 351 student ambassadors.

items.title: Medford High School Building Project Educational Plan
items.summary: Approved the educational plan for the Medford High School building project with an amendment allowing the superintendent to make non-substantive adjustments prior to submission.

items.title: Permanent Superintendent Appointment
items.summary: Following a discussion on stability, performance evaluations, and the potential disruption of an external search, the committee voted to appoint Dr. Suzanne Galusi as the permanent superintendent pending successful contract negotiations.
